name: B2B Quantity Manager for WooCommerce
author: VerseSofts

sections.description:
🚀 Premium Addons for Your Store:
* Conditional Store Restrictions (PRO) – The ultimate access control engine for WooCommerce.
* Price & Cart Hider (PRO) – Professional Catalog Mode & B2B pricing control.

B2B Quantity Manager for WooCommerce by VerseSofts is the professional-grade solution for store owners who need granular control over product purchase quantities. Whether you sell in bulk, items by weight, or items that must be bought in specific sets, this plugin provides the flexibility you need.

Replicating high-end functionality in a sleek package, our manager ensures your customers follow your business rules—reducing order errors and streamlining your fulfillment process.

✨ Key Features

  • Product-Level Limits: Enforce specific Minimum and Maximum quantity requirements for individual items.
  • Flexible Step Increments: Force purchases in specific increments (e.g., pairs of 2, packs of 6, or crates of 12).
  • Decimal Quantity Support: Enable precise sales for weight-based products (e.g., 0.5kg, 1.25kg) with built-in validation.
  • Quantity Dropdown UI: Replace standard number inputs with an elegant, user-friendly dropdown menu.
  • User Role Restrictions: Apply different rules for different customer segments (e.g., Wholesale vs. Retail).
  • Category-Level Rules: Set bulk quantity restrictions for entire product categories instantly.
  • Store-Wide Cart Restrictions: Enforce total cart quantity or subtotal amount limits before checkout.
  • Modern Admin Interface: A blazing fast settings dashboard to manage all your global rules in one place.

💼 Perfect For

  • Wholesale Stores: Require minimum order quantities (MOQ) for bulk pricing or specific user roles.
  • Grocery & Fresh Produce: Sell items by weight using decimal steps (e.g., meat, vegetables, or spices).
  • Boutique Retailers: Sell items that must be bought in pairs or sets (e.g., wine bottles or event tickets).
  • Manufacturing: Ensure orders match your batch sizes or packaging constraints.

Why Choose VerseSofts?

We build professional-grade tools to help your WooCommerce store scale. Explore our full range of solutions on our Official WooCommerce Marketplace Profile.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for B2B Quantity Manager for WooCommerce.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  4. Navigate to WooCommerce > Conditional Quantity Manager to configure your rules.
sections.faq:
Does it support decimal quantities?

Yes! You can set steps like 0.1 or 0.5 and the plugin will validate the math precisely on the frontend and backend.

Can I restrict rules to specific user roles?

Absolutely. Every rule can be targeted to specific roles or applied to all customers.

Is it compatible with HPOS?

Yes, the plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce’s latest standards, including HPOS and Blocks.
